title: sec.config.v1
description: Phase 7 §7.1 control-plane fan-out: announces that a sec-side config file (deterministic-pattern YAML, endpoint-cost map, ...) changed on disk. Consumers that already hold the announced sha256 skip the re-read (idempotent). Producer set is open within `sec.*` (any sec agent that detects a local mtime delta) plus the Phase 8 `ops_console` operator surface. Mirrors `ai/swarm/agents/payloads.py::SecConfigEvent`.

config_name.description: Closed enum: only the two sec-side config files have a hot-reload contract today.

sha256.description: Hex-encoded sha256 of the FILE BYTES the producer observed. The contract — consumers re-read the file and verify their local sha matches.

mtime_ns.description: Informational only; the sha256 is the contract. Defends against clock-skew across pods.
